reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the shared getScheduledAmount that every consumer already calls; the approx tolerance is still computed inline (Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075)) rather than via the existing getApproxNumberThreshold, a pre-existing gap the diff leaves.

duplication.why: The rule is changed once; the other edits are comment updates at the call sites.

placement.why: The change lands in shared/schedules.ts, the module that owns the expected-amount rule for server and client.

scope.why: Two expression edits in the helper, matching comment updates and test expectations only.

maintainability.why: Minimal, centralised change that every path picks up automatically.
